tooltip.daisychain.bloom_wrench: Sneak and right-click a pipe side to change it
tooltip.daisychain.bloom_wrench.open: Right-click a pipe to open its settings
tooltip.daisychain.bloom_wrench.hologram: Sneak and right-click anything else to turn the side holograms on or off
message.daisychain.nothing_to_connect: Nothing to connect on that side
tooltip.daisychain.upgrade.install: Right-click a pull side, or put it in the side's upgrade slot (replaces a lower tier)
tooltip.daisychain.upgrade.network: Sneak + right-click a pipe: upgrade every pull side on that network
tooltip.daisychain.upgrade.remove: Remove: sneak + right-click the side with an empty hand, or take it out of the upgrade slot
message.daisychain.upgrade_lower: This side has a better upgrade. Take it out first (sneak + right-click with an empty hand)
message.daisychain.upgrade_already: That side already has this upgrade
message.daisychain.upgrade_pull_only: Upgrades go on pull sides (use the Bloom Wrench to make one)
message.daisychain.network_upgraded: Upgraded %s pull sides on this network
message.daisychain.network_nothing: No pull sides on this network needed this upgrade
screen.daisychain.upgrade_parked: Parked: it only works while this side pulls, and stays here for when you switch it back
screen.daisychain.sides.upgrade_parked: Parked upgrade: %s (works when this side pulls)
screen.daisychain.matches.data: Matches this item with exactly this data
screen.daisychain.no_data: This entry has no extra data to match (none, or too large to store)
daisychain.configuration.title: Daisychain settings
daisychain.configuration.show_hints.tool: Show how-to hints in Daisychain screens. The ? button in the Pull side screen toggles this too.
daisychain.configuration.max_empty_wait_: Max wait when there is nothing to pull
daisychain.configuration.blocked_wait_ti: Item pipes: wait between tries when everything is full
daisychain.configuration.max_network_pas: Most sides per paste (and per undo)
screen.daisychain.batch_help: The most items moved at once. Max follows the upgrade, which is always the limit.
screen.daisychain.keep_help: Leaves at least this many of each item in the source and pulls only the extra.
screen.daisychain.number_help: Click +1, right-click -1 (Shift: 64). Alt: max / min. Scrolling works too. %s+click: type a number.
daisychain.configuration.max_slots_count: Largest inventory counted for Keep / Fill / Max stock
screen.daisychain.keep_paused: Paused: the source has more than %s slots, too many to count, so its items are left alone. Turn Keep off, or ask the server to raise max_slots_counted.
screen.daisychain.side_mode_long.pull: Pull: things are taken from here
screen.daisychain.view_3d_hint: Drag to turn, scroll to zoom
daisychain.configuration.wrench_hologram: While sneaking with a wrench, show and allow clicking a see-through ghost arm on each side without an arm. Off: change a side by clicking the pipe's own face on that side.
daisychain.configuration.sides_view_3d.t: Open the Pipe sides screen in the 3D view instead of the flat cube view. The button in that screen's top corner switches it too.
screen.daisychain.fill_help: Stops filling a destination once it holds this many of an item.
screen.daisychain.fill_paused: A destination has more than %s slots, too many to count, so it gets nothing from this side. Turn Fill to off, or ask the server to raise max_slots_counted.
screen.daisychain.entry_allow_only: Per-entry amounts only apply in Whitelist mode.
screen.daisychain.entry_numbers_help: Dim = follows the side. A number here only counts for what this entry matches. The most exact entry wins: +Data, item, tag, then mod.
screen.daisychain.priority_help: Higher priority gets filled first. Equal ones follow the pull side's Send to. Default 0, can go negative.
screen.daisychain.priority_number_help: Click +1, right-click -1 (Shift: 10). Alt: max / min. Scrolling works too. %s+click: type a number.
screen.daisychain.side_mode_long.insert: Insert: things are sent in here
screen.daisychain.side_mode_long.connect: Link: connected to the next pipe
screen.daisychain.max_stock_help: This block stops taking an item once it holds this many of it.
screen.daisychain.max_stock_paused: This block has more than %s slots, too many to count, so it gets nothing while Max stock is on. Turn it off, or ask the server to raise max_slots_counted.
screen.daisychain.entry_stock_help: Dim = follows the side's Max stock. A number here only counts for what this entry matches. The most exact entry wins.
message.daisychain.copier.copied: Copied %s settings from the %s side (%s filter entries)
message.daisychain.copier.pasted_no_upgr: Pasted onto the %s side, but no %s in your inventory
message.daisychain.copier.already: The %s side already has these settings
message.daisychain.copier.network_unchan: Every side already had these settings
message.daisychain.copier.confirm_paste: Sneak + right-click this side again to paste
message.daisychain.copier.confirm_networ: Sneak + right-click the center again to paste onto all %s pull sides of this network
Sneak + right-click the center again to paste onto all %s insert sides of this network
message.daisychain.copier.network_none_p: This network has no pull sides to paste onto
message.daisychain.copier.network_none_i: This network has no insert sides to paste onto
message.daisychain.copier.network_too_ma: That's %s sides, and this server allows %s per paste. Paste onto them in smaller groups
message.daisychain.copier.pasted_network: (%s without a %s: none left in your inventory)
message.daisychain.copier.undo_skipped: (%s left alone: changed since, removed or not loaded)
message.daisychain.copier.undo_missing: (%s kept their new upgrade: no %s in your inventory)
message.daisychain.copier.undo_gone: Paste #%s can't be undone: it was undone already, or it's older than your last %s pastes
message.daisychain.copier.undo_none: Nothing to undo: you haven't pasted anything lately
message.daisychain.copier.undo_other_dim: That paste was in another dimension. Go back there to undo it
message.daisychain.copier.no_side: Click a pull or insert side (a side facing an inventory)
message.daisychain.copier.empty: Nothing copied yet: right-click a pull or insert side first
message.daisychain.copier.wrong_pipe: These settings are from a different pipe type
tooltip.daisychain.copier.upgrade: Upgrade: %s (taken from your inventory when pasting)
tooltip.daisychain.copier.copy: Right-click a pull or insert side: copy its settings
tooltip.daisychain.copier.paste: Sneak + right-click a side of the same kind twice: paste them there
tooltip.daisychain.copier.paste_network: Sneak + right-click a pipe's center twice: paste onto the whole network
screen.daisychain.tab.this_side_none: The %s side isn't a pull or insert side any more
message.daisychain.copier.wrong_kind_pul: These are pull side settings, but this is an insert side. Make it a pull side first (Bloom Wrench or Pipe sides)
message.daisychain.copier.wrong_kind_ins: These are insert side settings, but this is a pull side. Make it an insert side first (Bloom Wrench or Pipe sides)
tooltip.daisychain.upgrade.fluid_speed: Fluid pipes: %s mB every %s ticks (about %s mB/s)
screen.daisychain.matches.fluid_data: Matches this fluid with exactly this data
screen.daisychain.batch_help_fluid: The most mB moved at once. Max follows the upgrade, which is always the limit.
screen.daisychain.keep_help_fluid: Leaves at least this many mB of each fluid in the source (1000 mB = 1 bucket).
screen.daisychain.fill_help_fluid: Stops filling a destination once it holds this many mB of a fluid.
screen.daisychain.max_stock_help_fluid: This block stops taking a fluid once it holds this many mB of it.
screen.daisychain.number_help_fluid: Click +100, right-click -100 mB (Shift: 1000). Alt: max / min. Scrolling works too. %s+click: type a number.
screen.daisychain.keep_paused_fluid: Paused: the source has more than %s tanks, too many to count, so its fluids are left alone. Turn Keep off, or ask the server to raise max_slots_counted.
screen.daisychain.fill_paused_fluid: A destination has more than %s tanks, too many to count, so it gets nothing from this side. Turn Fill to off, or ask the server to raise max_slots_counted.
screen.daisychain.max_stock_paused_fluid: This block has more than %s tanks, too many to count, so it gets nothing while Max stock is on. Turn it off, or ask the server to raise max_slots_counted.
screen.daisychain.entry_numbers_help_flu: Dim = follows the side. A number here (mB) only counts for what this entry matches. The most exact entry wins: +Data, fluid, tag, then mod.
screen.daisychain.entry_stock_help_fluid: Dim = follows the side's Max stock. A number here (mB) only counts for what this entry matches. The most exact entry wins.
tooltip.daisychain.upgrade.energy_speed: Universal pipes, energy: %s FE every %s tick(s) (about %s FE/t)
screen.daisychain.batch_help_energy: The most FE moved at once. Max follows the upgrade, which is always the limit.
screen.daisychain.keep_help_energy: Leaves at least this much FE in the source and pulls only the extra.
screen.daisychain.fill_help_energy: Stops filling a destination once it holds this much FE.
screen.daisychain.max_stock_help_energy: This block stops taking energy once it holds this much FE.
screen.daisychain.number_help_energy: Click +1,000, right-click -1,000 FE (Shift: 100,000). Alt: max / min. %s+click: type a number.
screen.daisychain.keep_paused_energy: Paused: Keep in source can't check this source. (%s)
screen.daisychain.fill_paused_energy: A destination was skipped: Fill destination to can't check it. (%s)
screen.daisychain.max_stock_paused_energ: Skipped: Max stock can't check this block. (%s)
screen.daisychain.resource_pull_help: Each resource has its own filter and amounts. Redstone, Send to and the upgrade are shared.
screen.daisychain.resource_accept_help: Each resource has its own filter and Max stock. Priority is shared.
screen.daisychain.status.starting.help: This side hasn't had its turn yet. Give it a moment.
screen.daisychain.status.moving.help: Things moved on its last turn.
screen.daisychain.status.waiting.help: There's something to move, but nothing took it. The destinations may be full, filtered or at their Max stock or Fill to, or Keep is holding it back.
screen.daisychain.status.nothing_to_pull: The block here is empty, or has nothing the filter lets through. It keeps checking and starts again when something shows up.
screen.daisychain.status.no_source.help: No inventory, tank or battery on this side. It wakes up as soon as one is placed.
This network has no insert sides yet. Connect it to a chest or machine to give things somewhere to go.
screen.daisychain.status.redstone_off.he: The Redstone setting is keeping this side off right now.
screen.daisychain.status.waiting_for_pul: Set to run once per redstone pulse. A button or a flicked lever sends one.
screen.daisychain.status.switched_off.he: Pulling this is switched off on this side. The power key turns it back on.
screen.daisychain.priority_key_hint: Click: Low / Normal / High   Right-click: back. Exact number in Advanced
screen.daisychain.view_hint: Click: switch (remembered on this pipe for everyone)
daisychain.configuration.open_advanced.t: Side screens open in Advanced view (all settings) when nobody has picked a view for that pipe yet. Off: Simple view. The sliders key in the screen switches a pipe's view for everyone.
daisychain.guide.name: Daisychain Guide
daisychain.guide.tooltip: Hold G over any Daisychain item to jump to its page.
screen.daisychain.entry.pick_tag: Match a whole tag. Pick one of this entry's tags below, or search them all.
screen.daisychain.entry.open_advanced_he: Opens the Advanced view with this entry still open, so you can give it its own amounts.
screen.daisychain.sides.view_3d_help: Switch between the flat view and a 3D view of the pipe and its neighbors
screen.daisychain.sides.mode_help.pull: Pull: takes things out of the block on this side
screen.daisychain.sides.mode_help.insert: Insert: delivers things into the block on this side
screen.daisychain.sides.mode_help.link: Link: connects to the next pipe
screen.daisychain.sides.mode_help.off: Off: this side does nothing and doesn't connect
screen.daisychain.sides.no_settings: Only pull and insert sides have settings
screen.daisychain.sides.select_hint: Click to select it, then pick a mode below
message.daisychain.holograms_off: Wrench holograms off: click the pipe itself to change a side
message.daisychain.upgrade_energy: Energy pipes don't take upgrades: craft a faster energy pipe instead
screen.daisychain.upgrade_unused_energy: Energy pipes don't use upgrades (their speed comes from the pipe's tier). Take it out.
screen.daisychain.sides.upgrade_unused: Unused upgrade: %s (energy pipes don't use upgrades)
tooltip.daisychain.energy_pipe.route: Joins energy pipes of every tier. Energy moves at the speed of the slowest pipe on its way to each machine.
tooltip.daisychain.energy_pipe.swap: Sneak + right-click a lower-tier energy pipe to swap it in place. Its sides and settings stay.
jade.daisychain.no_machines: Network speed: no machines to power yet
config.jade.plugin_daisychain.pipe_netwo: Daisychain pull side status and energy network speed
daisychain.configuration.energy_glow.too: The line along energy pipes stays lit in the dark. Only changes the look; it costs nothing per frame either way.
